{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Chainmail armor''' is craftable in Matcha Flavoured from iron chains. Every piece has Thorns III.

== Obtaining ==
Each piece uses the vanilla armor shape with iron chains. It is repaired with iron ingots and smelts back into an iron ingot in a blast furnace.
